title: Rippers — Stylish Shop (Slash Register, Guild)
description: An opt-in, look-only register skin for Stylish Shop's GUILD layout (grid family, the ledger / notice-board read) in the Rippers Unmasked "Slash" register: bone ground #e8dccb, blood #c8102a as attention/danger accent only, gold #efe0a0, ink #0b0607; Pirata One / Grenze Gotisch / IBM Plex Mono. A LIGHT re-ink of Guild's already-1892 material world (parchment / ink / brass / seal-red / wood / leather kept) plus register geometry (radius-0 plate rims, hard flat act-on shadows), the ink-prices rule (body-size numbers in mono ink; blood reserved for the focused/WANTED card, low/out-of-stock, and the active plate), and hidden Korean sublabels. Auto-applies to Guild shops on their default palette; opt a shop out by picking a native Guild palette (Thieves / Sacred / Druid). No mechanics, no transactions, no DOM rewrites. Designed for Stylish Shop 2.0.0. A personal-table module — not for redistribution.

recommends.reason: This module only restyles Stylish Shop's Guild layout; it has no effect unless Stylish Shop is installed and active. Designed against Stylish Shop 2.0.0.
Stylish Shop 2.0.0's own required dependency; listed for completeness.

rippers-stylish-shop-theme.note: Look-only skin scoped to .ss-shop-app.theme-grid-guild.palette-rippers. The esmodule adds the palette-rippers class to a Guild shop on its default palette (world setting 'autoApply', default true); a native Guild palette selection is the per-shop opt-out. Palette re-ink of Guild's --parchment/--brass/--seal-red/--ink to the Slash register; fonts win because the shop's default fontOverrides is empty. Verified by computed style + paint-check in the e2e-harness against Stylish Shop 2.0.0.
